title: Fundamental Duties (Article 51A)
quote: 8 - 10 - 11 = suggested by Swaran Singh - added in 1976 - total after 2002

boxes.title: Basics
items: **Part IV-A**, single Article ==**51A**==
Added by **42nd Amendment, 1976** ("Mini Constitution"); in force **3 January 1977**
Inspired by **USSR**; among democracies only **Japan** has a similar list
Apply ==**only to citizens**==; 51A(k) to **parents/guardians**
Originally **10**, now **11**

items.what: ==**86th Amendment**==: **51A(k)**, with Art. 21A and new Art. 45 = **11**

boxes.title: Swaran Singh: not accepted
items: **Penalty** for non-compliance by Parliament
Bar on court challenge to such penalty laws
**Duty to pay taxes**

boxes.title: Enforceability & cases
items: ==**Non-justiciable**==; no legal sanction; Parliament may legislate
Courts use them to judge **reasonableness** of laws
**Bijoe Emmanuel (1986)**: duties cannot override FRs
**AIIMS Students' Union (2002)**: rights and duties correlative
**M.K. Ranjitsinh**: CSR includes environment, 51A(g)
Laws: Prevention of Insults to National Honour Act **1971** → 51A(a)

boxes.title: Criticism
items: Not exhaustive: omits **voting, taxes, family planning**
Vague: "noble ideals", "composite culture"
"**Code of moral precepts**"; placed as appendage to Part IV

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: 11th duty = ==**86th, 2002**== - not 96th, not 2001 (APPSC G2 2025)
NOT a duty: protect **elderly, differently abled, children** (G2 2025, twice); pay taxes; vote
Environmental FD = **51A(g)** (APPSC 2025), not 48A
Swaran Singh (**1976**) ≠ J.S. Verma (**1999**)
Moral: b, f, h, j; civic: a, c, d, g, i
